checks.name: logic_fallacy_explicit
checks.value: R75 exposed an absolute-bound-versus-Lipschitz-bound error: an absolute per-node height cap of 0.035 m does not imply a relative 3 m neighbor-difference cap. The first R76 attempt then exposed a second constraint-composition error: clamping a candidate to the node cap and afterwards clamping it to a neighbor interval can undo the node cap if the intervals do not coincide. R76 now intersects both admissible intervals first and only then clamps once. It neither lowers the 1.05 m QA threshold nor assumes that passing this local relation proves whole-slope visual acceptance.
checks.limit: absolute node bound is not a local Lipschitz bound
